title: r2c.latest/v1
description: Session routing index (`.r2c/latest.json`). Route data only: status lives in each run's state.json. A missing or unknown schema is treated as an empty index.

runs.description: Keyed by session id (real, or synthetic cli-<runId> until claimed).

active_run_id.description: Most recent run with an active route, for read-only commands without a session id.

latest_run_id.description: Most recent run regardless of activity.
